test_is_likely_binary: test the _is_likely_binary method to classify files as binary or text based on content analysis
test_check_lint: test the _check_lint method to run linters on supported file types and return lint results
test_binary_extension_short_circuit: test that known binary extensions like .png and .tar.gz short-circuit content analysis
test_content_threshold_boundary: test the 30% non-printable character threshold boundary for binary classification
test_lint_curly_brace_paths: test that _check_lint handles file paths containing curly braces without errors
